title: Cranes - Control - Layout and characteristics, Part 3: Tower cranes
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO 7752 specifies the particular requirements for controls for tower cranes as defined in ISO 4306-1 and ISO 4306-3 and the arrangennent of basic controls used for positioning loads. NOTE 1 For the general principles and requirements for the controls of cranes, see ISO 7752-1. It applies to the controls of — tower cranes for building and general construction work that can be disnnantled, — pernnanently erected tower cranes, — hannmerhead cranes, — dockside and shipbuilders' tower cranes. It does not apply to the controls of — power-driven mobile jib cranes which may be fitted with a tower attachment, — erection masts, with or >A/ithout jibs.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
